installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Fabric MC Installation Script for Cinammon.net
# Server Files: /mnt/server
apt update
apt install -y curl jq openjdk-17-jre-headless wget unzip dos2unix
mkdir -p /mnt/server /mnt/server/mods
cd /mnt/server

if [ -z "" ] || [ "" == "latest" ]; then
  MC_VERSION=
elif [ "" == "snapshot" ]; then
  MC_VERSION=
fi

if [ -z "" ] || [ "" == "latest" ]; then
  FABRIC_VERSION=
fi

if [ -z "" ] || [ "" == "latest" ]; then
  LOADER_VERSION=
elif [ "" == "snapshot" ]; then
  LOADER_VERSION=
fi

echo "Downloading Fabric Installer  for MC  (Loader )..."
wget -O fabric-installer.jar "https://maven.fabricmc.net/net/fabricmc/fabric-installer//fabric-installer-.jar"
java -jar fabric-installer.jar server -mcversion "" -loader "" -downloadMinecraft
mv server.jar minecraft-server.jar
mv fabric-server-launch.jar server.jar
echo "serverJar=minecraft-server.jar" > fabric-server-launcher.properties
mkdir -p /mnt/server/mods
echo "Install Complete"
